summary: Ran the whole 'Admin - Model Vessel - Route Planning' wizard again (28 steps plus the finish panel) as pro user test_session_pro_1 on the Model Vessel at 390x844, doing each step as written. Wizard text in the DB and in the UI is correct: Step 4 includes MARLBOROUGH SOUNDS DEMO, Step 11 does not mention the Map tab (there is no Map tab), Steps 15/22/24/26 say to pick the tank and battery levels before ARRIVED, Step 17 says New departure opens empty and uses 'Ship Cove, Marlborough Sounds', and Step 28 describes the Trip - Route Plan entry and its Show the full entry arrow. FIX 1 works: with the full training window open, every dialog sits above it (Add Leg dialog 8-625px, window 633-844px). Normal clicks work on Mooring, Anchoring, Returning to Dock, Save Leg 2/3/4, Back to the trip plan, Looks good and the Delete Model Vessel AlertDialog Cancel. With the window shrunk to mini, the Add Leg dialog grows to 50-738px. No horizontal overflow. FIX 3 works: the label reads 'EVENT OR TRIP NAME' with no (optional), the red alert navigator-event-name-required shows while the name is empty and goes away once it is typed, and DEPART with an empty name shows 'Enter the Event or Trip name on Route Planning before you depart.' In the New departure dialog the field stays '(OPTIONAL)' with no alert. CRITICAL bug found and fixed: BoatPrep.jsx called withTripLog but never imported it. Adding any Ship's Log entry (Step 20, the dolphins entry) crashed the app with 'withTripLog is not defined'. I added the import. After that fix, FIX 2 works: the dolphins entry was put on leg 2's logs, and after Log arrival it is no longer its own row. It now sits inside the Trip entry's detail under 'Ship's Log entries folded into this trip', and the leg lines use the entered Departure times (17/11 06:00, 18/11 06:00, 19/11 06:00), with Leg 2 arriving 17/11 08:00. The first departure log line contains MARLBOROUGH SOUNDS DEMO. Problem still open: the folded Trip entry title and the leg 2-4 departure and arrival log lines use 'Route Planning' (the list name), not MARLBOROUGH SOUNDS DEMO. Regression on the main boat TEST_Kia Ora: no training window or body class, dialogs are centred, and the name label and alert behave the same. I could not run a full depart there because that boat's list menu has no Leaving Dock list.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: withTripLog was used at line ~732 but not imported from @/lib/tripFold. Adding any Ship's Log entry on any boat threw the runtime error 'withTripLog is not defined' and crashed the app. Added it to the import.

integration_issues.issue: The fold entry title is 'Trip - Route Plan: Route Planning - Mana Marina, Porirua to Mana Marina, Porirua, 16/11/2026 - 19/11/2026 - 4 legs'. It uses underway.name (the list name) and not the Event or Trip name MARLBOROUGH SOUNDS DEMO (useAllDone.js line 155: foldTrip(..., u.name || 'Route Plan', ...)). The leg 2-4 'Interim departure' and 'Arrived' log lines also read 'Route Planning Ship Cove...-Tawa Bay', because the New departure dialog's event name is blank (optional) and the line head falls back to t.name (allDone.js line 44). Suggest using the trip's weather.event_name for the fold title, and carrying it into the interim legs when they leave the name blank.

critical_code_review_comments: BoatPrep.jsx used withTripLog without importing it. This was a runtime crash on every Ship's Log add; ESLint no-undef should have caught it.

withTripLog falls back to b.route_trip when not underway. After the fold, legs[route_trip] is [], so nothing attaches, which is fine. But between legs (arrived, not yet departed) any Ship's Log note is attached to the trip, even unrelated ones. This is acceptable by design, but worth knowing.
useAllDone.js line 155 passes u.name (the list name) to foldTrip as tripName. The trip's event_name should be used.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all wizard steps and FIX 1/2/3 pass after the import fix; trip name missing from the fold title and the interim lines)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard step position is in localStorage (mbp_model_step:<uid>), so each new browser context starts at Basic Introduction. To resume, open Help menu: app-menu-btn > app-menu-help-item > app-menu-help-model-vessel-item > app-menu-help-model-wizard-route-planning..., then press training-next-btn N-1 times. The Add Leg dialog, the checklist peek and the arrive dialog can now be clicked normally. In the arrive dialog, all-done-choice-<mooring|anchor> logs straight away (no confirm). Returning to Dock uses all-done-confirm-btn ('Log arrival'). The New departure dialog is interim-departure-dialog, with route-start/dest, navigator-depart-at/finish-at inputs and interim-departure-<mooring|anchor|berth>-btn. On load, the main boat TEST_Kia Ora shows an 'Arrived?' prompt (press 'Not yet') and has no Leaving Dock list in its list menu. Backup and restore scripts: /tmp/bk.py and /tmp/main.py (they may not survive).
